short_description.text: Onesimus — a Colossian who was Paul's faithful and beloved brother (COL 4:9).
Jesus Justus — Paul's fellow worker from the circumcision (COL 4:11).
Demas — sent greetings via Paul to the Colossians (COL 4:14).
Nympha — had a church in her house in Colossae (COL 4:15).
Archippus — reminded by Paul to take heed of the ministry received from the Lord (COL 4:17).
Colossae is a place named in Scripture (Col.1.2).
Hierapolis is a place named in Scripture (Col.4.13).
Laodicea is a place named in Scripture (Col.2.1–Rev.3.14).
